messages:
ops-bot: PAGER: High 95th latency on /v1/generate in eu-central; token throughput down ~60%; error spike 502/504 for economy tier. Triggered by 5xx increase at 23:07 UTC.
ashley (oncall): ack — joining. who is taking lead?
samir: i'll take it. pulling traces and routing weights now. looks like economy lane is getting heavy fanout to quantized variant causing GC stalls on a subset of hosts.
jess: cs: 3 support tickets so far, one enterprise account saw timeouts; flagged to account execs. no public status yet.
marta: adding context — recent canary for model-quant-q8 pushed last night to eu-central economy. could be correlated.
samir: confirmed correlation window matches deploy at 22:48 UTC. rolling back isn't safe without traffic steering, propose emergency routing change to throttle economy weight in eu-central and push traffic to low-latency premium model variant.
ashley (oncall): plan sounds good. TL;DR mitigation steps?
kevin: suggest this sequence — 1) apply soft weight reduce to economy (0.05) 2) open short-lived quota to premium for affected customers 3) enable fallback to low-latency model for requests > 500ms 95th.
samir: will execute step 1 now via redwoodctl. running: 
```
redwoodctl routing update --region eu-central --policy route-sculpt-emergency \
  --set economy_weight=0.05,premium_weight=0.9,overflow=local-fallback \
  --reason "mitigate latency spike after q8 canary"
```
ops-bot: ACTION: routing change applied (op-id: rchg-2867500000). New weights: economy=0.05, premium=0.9, overflow=fallback. Propagated to edge in ~12s.
samir: monitoring now — tail latency 95th dropping from 1.2s -> 420ms within 30s. error rate decreasing.
jess: CS update: telling affected customers we'll keep them posted; opening incident page.
ashley (oncall): step 2 — temporarily increase premium quota for the affected team IDs to avoid rejecting traffic. kevin do you want to run the quota bump?
kevin: running quota bump for impacted orgs (org-412, org-777). cmd: `redwoodctl quota adjust --org org-412,org-777 --pool premium --delta +30% --ttl 15m` — applied.
marta: putting a hold on auto-canary rollout for quant-q8 in eu-central and notifying model-onboarding.
samir: logging mitigation in incident runbook and creating roll-forward ticket to revert route after stability window. also adding a metric alert for economy weight > 0.02 & latency > 500ms.
ops-bot: NOTE: no customer-facing outage declared. degraded perf for some orgs; mitigated. Incident severity: Sev2 -> monitoring for 30m.
ashley (oncall): good work. follow-ups: (1) postmortem with timeline & rollback triggers, (2) tighter canary gating for quantized variants, (3) add automatic emergency cutover to premium if 95th > 600ms for 60s. assign owners on incident page.
jess: created incident-doc: https://internal.redwood/incident/2867500000-route-sculpt. linked CS and SRE runbooks.
kevin: after 15m stability, gradually open economy back to normal weights in 10% increments. will coordinate.
samir: confirmed stable at 12min, ready for slow ramp at +0.1 every 5m. canary will stay blocked until follow-up.
ashley (oncall): handing back to oncall rotation — leaving samir as incident owner for postmortem. closing pager for now. :white_check_mark:
